## Free offers (no payment, no signup)
1. Sales Credibility Index™ — https://yousufefti.com/diagnostic.html — 10 questions drawn from a 40-question bank across 6
   dimensions (market/position, offer/price, pipeline hygiene, proof/trust, conversion mechanics, retention/referral).
   Each answer scores 0-3; the index is the dimension average on a 0-100 scale; the report lists the three lowest
   dimensions with a prescribed first move and an impact window (this week / 14 days / 30 days). Report delivery:
   the visitor's own email client, WhatsApp, or a .txt download — no data leaves the visitor's device unless they
   send it.
2. 10-point Sales Credibility Checklist — https://yousufefti.com/index.html#magnet.
3. 30-minute sales performance call, live availability — https://yousufefti.com/book.html.

## Programs (per corporate cohort, BDT, 50% on scheduling)
- AI-Integrated Pharma Sales Leadership for High Performance — 3 days, In-house · 3 days · 25-35 pax, ৳420,000. For Sr. Area Managers and NSMs: run a territory like a business — pipeline, coaching cadence, and AI-assisted field decisions. Modules: From supervisor to leader: the identity shift nobody trains you for; Territory maths: coverage, frequency, growth share, drop-size; The 4-check weekly review that replaces the 'how many calls did you do' walk; AI in the field: call planning, objection drills, debrief summaries; Conflict, retention and the exit conversation you keep delaying; 90-day change plan with a manager scorecard.
- AI-Integrated Pharma Selling Skills for High Performance — 2 days, In-house · 2 days, ৳280,000. Field reps: pre-call planning, probing, brand-detail closing, and the follow-up that most reps simply never do. Modules: The 90-second opening that earns the rest of the call; Probing before pitching: 7 questions that qualify a doctor or a depot; Detailing to a decision, not to a nod; Objection drills with AI-generated hard cases; Follow-up spine: 24h recap, day-3 proof, day-7 ask.
- Train-the-Trainer (ToT) — IFC-LPI aligned — 5 days, 5 days + assessment, ৳95,000. Turn your best performers into certified internal trainers: content design, facilitation, evaluation, KPI handoff. Modules: Adult learning and why 3-slide decks fail; Module design: objective → activity → measure; Stage control: voice, silence, movement, questions; Handling the difficult room; Evaluation: Kirkpatrick beyond the smile sheet.
- Newly Promoted Sales Leaders: Forming to Performing — 2 days, 2 days + 3 follow-up clinics, ৳65,000. The first 180 days of leading a team that used to be your peers — the four stages and what to do in each. Modules: Forming: set the contract, not the target; Storming: conflict scripts that keep people; Norming: rituals, cadence, visible scoreboards; Performing: coaching the top and the tail.
- AI-Integrated Emotional Intelligence for Sales Professionals — 1 day, 1 day, ৳150,000. Read the room, then use the read: EQ applied to buying signals, depot moods and angry customers. Modules: Four buying emotions and the words each one wants; De-escalation in 4 moves; AI as rehearsal: simulate the hard conversation.
- The Art of Sales Negotiation & Relationship Building — 2 days, 2 days, ৳240,000. Margins, credit terms, listing fees and stockist politics — protect the price, keep the person. Modules: What you can actually concede (and what you only pretend to); Trade terms: listing, expiry, credit, scheme; The 3 asks that reopen a stalled deal.
- Customer Service Excellence for Depot In-Charges — 1 day, 1 day, ৳120,000. Order accuracy, returns, response time and the depot voice that decides whether a rep's promise survives. Modules: The four moments a customer decides to stay; Returns and credit conversations without blame.
- Futuristic Pharma Marketing for PMD Leaders — 2 days, 2 days, ৳260,000. Brand strategy that survives a commodity market: segmentation, launch sequencing, field-marketing alignment, AI research. Modules: Positioning a molecule in a crowded shelf; Launch sequencing: pilot, proof, pressure; Marketing that field reps can actually use.

## Published positions (from Md Yousuf Efti, PhD's own writing)
- A new team needs a contract before a target: agree what you will always say, what you will never do, what you need from them.
- Storming is healthy when it has a route: put the objection on the Friday list and decide it with data.
- Culture is rituals, not rhetoric: Monday five must-win calls, Friday lost-deal review, monthly field day with the weakest rep.
- Coaching cadence stops when a manager gets promoted into meetings — that is exactly when a top performer starts leaving.
- In disruption, protect the credit line before the calendar; a customer who negotiates terms with you stays, one who is chased leaves.
- Coverage beats call volume when roads are unreliable: one 12-minute call with a decision-maker beats six rushed ones.
- During disruption the depot is the real customer: order accuracy, stock split and returns decide whether the promise survives.
- AI pre-call planning: three dictated inputs, ninety seconds, a predicted objection and one fallback question. Measured lift
  came from closure-per-call (21% → 38%), not from call count (11.4 → 11.9/day).
- Never discount the day the market reopens: it trains the trade to wait you out.
- Evaluations must be pullable from the client's MIS, or they do not count as an outcome.

## Language and delivery
Bangla and English in the same room: slides and handouts in English, facilitation and roleplay in Bangla, written
assessment in whichever language the participant thinks in. Every page of this site is bilingual.
